title: 2019 Panini Absolute - Rookie #176 Julian Love (RC) New York Giants
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2019 Panini Absolute sports trading card features Julian Love, a rookie player from the National Football League (NFL) team, New York Giants. The card number is 176 and it belongs to the base set. 

The card is perfect for collectors who are looking for a rare and valuable addition to their collection. It has been manufactured by Panini and is part of the 2019 season set. This trading card is a must-have for all football enthusiasts and fans of the New York Giants.
